content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"Aviation Systems is a research and development program run by U.S. Special Operations Command (SOCOM), funded through the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"bf2b92554d9a5fe0"}},{"text":"The program covers a portfolio of Special Operations aircraft, including the AC/MC-130J, CV-22, rotary wing aircraft and Armed Overwatch, along with small unmanned aircraft system (sUAS) work under the Adaptive Airborne Enterprise (A2E).","citation":{"fact_id":"813374c843163454"}},{"text":"One project, Aviation Systems Advanced Development (SF100), provides for the development, rapid prototyping, demonstration, and integration of maturing technologies for Special Operations-peculiar (SO-p) aviation and training requirements, spanning areas such as electronic warfare countermeasures, a high-energy laser for the AC-130J, and the Adaptive Airborne Enterprise.","citation":{"fact_id":"e255dd8665954fc7"}},{"text":"The CV-22 project (SF200) supports integration, design, development, prototyping and testing of the CV-22 Osprey, a Special Operations Forces variant of the V-22 tiltrotor that provides long-range, high-speed, all-weather infiltration, exfiltration and resupply of SOF teams.","citation":{"fact_id":"160cf4685f0399fd"}},{"text":"The Armed Overwatch/Targeting project (SF300) supports integration and testing for the Armed Overwatch program, which provides SOF with crewed, deployable, affordable aircraft able to perform close air support, precision strike, and armed intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) in irregular warfare operations.","citation":{"fact_id":"2ef09ecfcbe31a90"}},{"text":"The AC/MC-130J project (S875) supports development, rapid prototyping, integration and testing of the AC-130J Ghostrider gunship and the MC-130J Commando II, which handle close air support, air interdiction, and clandestine infiltration/resupply of SOF.","citation":{"fact_id":"13590450eee4a4d9"}},{"text":"The Rotary Wing Aviation project (D615) develops and integrates technologies for SO-peculiar rotary-wing aircraft including the MH-60M, MH-47G, A/MH-6, and the Future Long Range Assault Aircraft (FLRAA).","citation":{"fact_id":"22ab38ae654f7b2d"}},{"text":"The Mission Training and Preparation Systems project (S750) funds training and simulator systems, including an Extended Reality (XR) fixed-wing training program covering platforms such as the AC-130J, MC-130J, CV-22 and Armed Overwatch.","citation":{"fact_id":"7a931a3735bde784"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"The program's actual spending in fiscal year 2024 was about $197.5 million (in thousands of dollars), reflecting the scale of SOCOM's aviation R&D effort.","citation":{"fact_id":"c9e4c2fddbdb8b8a"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2025 the program totaled about $241.4 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"ab8eb0ecf98386f6"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2026 the program totals about $225.2 million, made up of roughly $119.7 million in discretionary funding and $105.5 million in mandatory (reconciliation) funding.","citation":{"fact_id":"746218297d3d60df"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total is about $16.2 million lower than 2025, a decrease of roughly 6.7 percent, showing a modest year-over-year decline.","citation":{"fact_id":"2c6945fd01e1bb62"}},{"text":"The mandatory (reconciliation) funds support the A2E effort, beginning a second phase to develop an open system architecture enabling multi-platform control and continuing work on the Human Autonomy Common Control Architecture (HACCAr), which has demonstrated managing multiple autonomous unmanned aircraft simultaneously.","citation":{"fact_id":"746218297d3d60df"}},{"text":"The discretionary portion of the fiscal year 2026 request is about $119.7 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"a7253e6f86d22aa2"}},{"text":"The mandatory reconciliation portion of the fiscal year 2026 request is about $105.5 million.","citation":{"fact_id":"4a64284efba31bbd"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"Lobbying filings from Lockheed Martin Corporation in 2024 referenced aviation matters, including issues related to aircraft and helicopters in the Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2025.","citation":{"fact_id":"04100b37887ce965"}},{"text":"A 2025 Lockheed Martin filing referenced HR 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, Title II, including issues related to aircraft, space programs, and intelligence programs.","citation":{"fact_id":"1de4f074700ded6d"}},{"text":"A 2025 Lockheed Martin filing referenced the Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2026, including issues related to tactical fixed-wing aviation.","citation":{"fact_id":"03e15cdf25ba2de0"}},{"text":"Lobbying filings from The Boeing Company in 2024 referenced aviation and aerospace programs, including FAA reauthorization legislation.","citation":{"fact_id":"1110a863f113df19"}},{"text":"A filing by The Doerrer Group LLC, on behalf of The Boeing Company, in 2024 referenced strategic advice related to aviation legislation.","citation":{"fact_id":"47d07ef4ac4f253b"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
